name: Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Mustafar)
description: This T-series tactical droid was deployed alongside a second tactical droid on a Battlesphere above the planet Mustafar. The droid gave orders to B1 Battle Droids during Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano's fight with EG-07. Both tactical droids were destroyed by the Jedi.
